STEP 11. Check the power supply voltage at crankshaft 
position sensor connector B-20.
(1) Disconnect connector B-20 and measure at the harness 
side.
(2) Turn the ignition switch to "ON" position.
(3) Measure the voltage between terminal 3 and ground.
• Voltage should be battery positive voltage.
(4) Turn the ignition switch to "LOCK" (OFF) position.
Q: Is the voltage normal?
YES : Go to Step 13.
NO : Go to Step 12.
STEP 12. Check connector A-21X at MFI relay for damage.
Q: Is the connector in good condition?
YES : Repair it because of harness open circuit or short 
circuit to ground between MFI relay connector A-21X 
terminal 1 and crankshaft position sensor connector 
B-20 terminal 3.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2.
